name: Annotely
title: annotely.com
shortDescription: Annotely is a web-based tool designed for easy screenshot annotation and markup, ideal for professionals needing to share visual ideas quickly. It operates directly from any modern browser without the need for installation, supporting both mobile and desktop devices. Users can draw, highlight, and annotate images using a comprehensive set of tools, making it perfect for tutorials, team collaborations, or personal note-taking.
pros: Works on all devices and browsers
Free to start without credit card
cons: No native app for offline use
